description: Anime-focused SDXL finetune with published recommended sampler settings (Euler a, low CFG, ~28 steps) and a masterpiece/best-quality tag convention. Common community-recommended starting point, not tuned against a specific install.
positive_prompt_prefix: masterpiece, best quality, very aesthetic, absurdres
negative_prompt_prefix: lowres, bad anatomy, bad hands, text, error, missing fingers, extra digit, fewer digits, cropped, worst quality, low quality
